summary_1line: Sanjaya explains that knowledge, faith, and control of the senses reveal Krishna as the supreme reality, while Duryodhana rejects surrender despite warnings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Blind king Dhritarashtra sits on his throne while Sanjaya stands before him describing Krishna’s cosmic nature in a dim royal court.
Duryodhana stands defiantly in the palace hall refusing to bow to Krishna as Dhritarashtra and Gandhari warn him of ruin.
Gandhari, veiled and sorrowful, raises her hand in anguish as she foretells Duryodhana struck down by Bhima on the battlefield.
